terms.title: Terms of Service
intro: Welcome to {name}. These terms are an agreement between you and {name} ("we" or "us") covering your use of the {name} website, console and API (together, the "Service"). By signing up for, signing in to or using the Service, you confirm that you have read and agree to these terms and our [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
If you use the Service on behalf of a company or other organization, you confirm that you are authorized to accept these terms for it.

sections.title: The Service
body: The Service gives you access to text and image models from multiple providers through a single API, billed by actual usage. The models and prices currently available are listed on the [Models](/catalog) and [Pricing](/pricing) pages.

The Service offers three channels: Shared, Dedicated and Enterprise. See the [Channels](/channels) page for what each includes. You choose a group when you create an API key, and the group name shows which channel it belongs to.
For the Enterprise channel, the scope, prices and commitments are set by the signed contract. Where the contract and these terms differ, the contract prevails.

sections.title: Accounts and API keys
body: Sign up with an email address you can receive mail at, or sign in with Google. Your account is for your own use only. Do not lend, transfer or sell it.

Keep your password and API keys safe. All calls made with your account or keys count toward your usage and are charged to your balance. If a key leaks, delete it in the console right away. If your account is compromised, contact us as soon as possible.
If you join an organization, your calls there are limited by the quota its admin sets, and the admin can see your email, your name in the organization, your quota and how much of it you have used.

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: When using the Service, you must not:
- break applicable laws, or create or spread illegal, infringing, fraudulent, sexual, violent or otherwise harmful content;
- violate the usage policies published by the provider of the model you call (such as the usage policies of OpenAI, Anthropic and Google);
- attack or disrupt the Service or upstream services, probe for vulnerabilities, or get around billing, quota, rate or security limits;
- register accounts in bulk, lend, transfer or sell accounts, or abuse referral rewards, promo codes or other promotions;
- infringe the intellectual property, privacy or other rights of others.

We may run automated safety checks on requests. If you break these terms, we may refuse the requests involved and limit, suspend or close your account as appropriate. You are liable under applicable law for any loss caused to us or others.

sections.title: Billing and top-ups
body: The Service is pay-as-you-go, with no monthly fee and no minimum spend. Each call is charged to your balance at the unit price of the group used at the time of the call. Balances are in US dollars. The [Pricing](/pricing) page shows the actual unit price of each group, and every charge is itemized in the console.

Prices may change, for example when a provider changes its prices. New prices apply from the time they are published on the Pricing page. Completed calls are charged at the price in effect when they were made.
You can top up with redeem codes or other methods we offer, and the funds are available once credited. Balances cannot be withdrawn or transferred to another account.
Amounts received through referral rewards, promo codes, promotions and similar means ("bonus credit") can only be spent on the Service. They cannot be withdrawn or refunded.
Invoices (not VAT invoices) are available for the Dedicated and Enterprise channels. Contact us to request one. Bank transfers are not supported at this time.

sections.title: Refunds
body: Within 7 days of a top-up, you can contact us to request a refund of the unused part of that top-up.
Top-ups older than 7 days, amounts already spent and bonus credit are not refundable.
Refunds go back through the original payment method, and the arrival time depends on that payment channel. We may refuse refunds that abuse this policy, such as using refunds to extract bonus credit.
Refunds for the Enterprise channel follow the contract.

sections.title: Availability
body: We do our best to keep the Service stable, but we do not guarantee that it will be uninterrupted or error-free. Provider outages, network issues and maintenance can cause calls to fail or slow down.
Providers may change or retire models, and we will adjust the available models accordingly. When downtime for maintenance is needed, we will try to give notice in advance.

sections.title: Inputs and outputs
body: You are responsible for the content you submit to the Service and confirm that you have the right to use it.
Model outputs are generated by AI and may be inaccurate, incomplete or untrue. They are not legal, medical, financial or other professional advice. Review and verify them before you rely on them.

As between you and us, you own your inputs and outputs, and we claim no rights in them. Your use of outputs must also follow the policies of the relevant provider. See the [Privacy Policy](/privacy) for how we handle your content.

sections.title: Suspension and termination
body: You can stop using the Service at any time. To close your account, contact us.
We may suspend or close your account if you break these terms or the law, or if the account poses a security risk.
If we decide to shut down the Service, we will notify you in advance and refund the unused top-up balance in your account (excluding bonus credit).

sections.title: Disclaimer and limitation of liability
body: The Service is provided as is. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect losses, lost profits or lost data arising from service interruptions, model outputs, the acts of third-party providers, poorly protected keys or similar causes.

To the extent permitted by law, our total liability to you in connection with the Service is limited to the amount you actually paid for the Service in the 3 months before the event giving rise to the claim.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. Updates are posted on this page with a new date, and we will notify you by email or in-site notice of changes that materially affect your rights. If you keep using the Service after an update takes effect, you accept the updated terms.

sections.title: Disputes
body: Any dispute arising from these terms or the Service should first be resolved through good-faith negotiation. If that fails, either party may bring the dispute before a competent court where we are located.

sections.title: Contact us
body: If you have any questions about these terms, email us at {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what information {name} ("we" or "us") collects when you use the {name} website, console and API (together, the "Service"), how we use and protect it, and what rights you have. This policy is part of our [Terms of Service](/terms).

sections.title: Information we collect
body: - **Account information**: your sign-up email, the username you set and your password (stored only as a hash, so we never see the original). If you sign in with Google, we receive the email, name and account ID of your Google account.
- **Organization information**: when you create or join an organization, its name, your name in it and the quota the admin sets for you.
- **Call records**: for each call, the time, model, usage (such as tokens or images), cost, duration, the API key and group used, the source IP address and client information (User-Agent).
- **Billing records**: changes to your balance, such as top-ups, redeem codes, referral rewards and charges.

- **Security records**: the time, IP address and device information of account actions such as sign-ins and profile changes; for failed calls, the error type and the error message returned by the provider.

sections.title: Your request content
body: For regular calls, we forward your request to the relevant model provider and return the result to you. We do not store the content of requests or responses, with two exceptions:
- **Async or batch image jobs**: we temporarily store a prompt summary and the generated images so you can check and download them once the job is done.

- **Safety checks**: to prevent abuse, we may run automated safety checks on request content, possibly using a third-party moderation service. For requests flagged as possible violations, we keep a short excerpt (with keys and other secrets removed) as the basis for handling them.

sections.title: Website and cookies
body: The website and console use no analytics or ad tracking tools. Cookies are only used to keep you signed in and for a temporary check during Google sign-in.
Preferences such as theme and table columns are stored in your browser. If you open the site through a referral link, the referral code is also kept in your browser and submitted when you sign up.

When human verification is enabled on pages such as sign-in and sign-up, it is provided by Cloudflare Turnstile, and Cloudflare processes some browser and device information under its own privacy policy.

sections.title: How we use information
body: - To provide the Service: verify your identity, forward calls, bill usage and show your usage;
- For support: handle your questions, refunds and invoice requests;
- For security: detect unusual sign-ins, account theft, fraud and abuse;
- To send notices: verification codes, password reset emails and service notices about your account;
- To comply with laws and regulatory requirements.
We do not use your information for advertising, and we do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Who we share it with
body: - **Model providers**: the models you call are provided by third parties (such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, most of them located outside mainland China). Your request content is sent to the relevant provider, which processes it under its own policies.

- **Infrastructure providers**: the providers we use to run the Service, such as cloud servers, network acceleration and protection (such as Cloudflare) and email delivery, process information only as needed to provide their services.
- **Google**: if you choose to sign in with Google, Google handles that sign-in.
- **Organization admins**: if you join an organization, its admin can see your email, your name in the organization, your quota and how much of it you have used.
- **Legal requirements**: we may disclose information when required by law or by judicial or government authorities.

sections.title: Retention
body: We keep account information for as long as your account exists, and call and billing records as needed for reconciliation, support and legal requirements. After you close your account, we delete or anonymize your personal information within a reasonable period, unless the law requires us to keep it.

sections.title: Security
body: We protect your information with encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords and access controls. No system is perfectly secure, so keep your password and API keys safe and act quickly if they leak.
If a personal information security incident occurs, we will notify you promptly as required by law and take steps to remedy it.

sections.title: Your rights
body: - Change your username and password in the console account settings;
- View your call and billing records in the console, and export your call records;
- Delete API keys you no longer use at any time;
- Contact us to close your account, or to ask about, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you.

sections.title: Minors
body: The Service is intended for adults and businesses. People under 18 must not sign up for or use it. If we learn that we have collected information from a minor, we will delete it promptly.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy. Updates are posted on this page with a new date, and we will notify you of material changes by email or in-site notice.

sections.title: Contact us
body: If you have any questions about this policy or want to exercise the rights above, email us at {email}.
